description: Earthquakes near Puerto Rico (within 250 km of the island's centre) in the last hours, newest first, from the U.S. Geological Survey's magnitude 2.5+ feed: magnitude, place, time (UTC), depth, distance from the island's centre and its coast, felt reports, estimated intensity, and `alert` — why 787daily's alert rule rings for it (magnitude 4.5+ within 150 km, 4.0+ within 50 km of the coast, or a USGS damage or intensity flag) — or null for a quake too small or far to alert. read=false means USGS did not answer, never an all-quiet. Most quakes here are small and harmless; never call one dangerous unless `alert` says so. Cite the USGS event page returned and 787daily.com/live/.

hours.description: How many hours back to look (1 to 24; default 24)

minMagnitude.description: The smallest magnitude to return (2.5 or more; default 2.5)

name: get_recent_earthquakes
title: Recent earthquakes near Puerto Rico
